result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major content bug showing "€NaN delivery" for Smash Bros Burgers, and a minor visual artifact in the promotional banner's decorative background.

issues.description: The delivery price under "Smash Bros Burgers" displays "€NaN delivery" instead of a valid numeric amount.
issues.suggestion: Fix the fee calculation/rendering so a valid price (e.g., "€0.00 delivery") is shown, and add a fallback for missing fee data.

issues.description: The "3 free deliveries for you" promotional banner has overlapping translucent circular shapes and a visible hard-edged diagonal seam/artifact across the right portion of the green background, making the graphic look broken.
issues.suggestion: Replace or correctly render the decorative background shapes so edges blend smoothly and no misaligned polygon/clipping artifact is visible.
